import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

from gen import generate
from backtest import run_backtest, FORECASTERS

PNG_PATH = "backtest_chart.png"
MD_PATH = "backtest_report.md"


def make_chart(df: pd.DataFrame, results: dict, path: str = PNG_PATH) -> str:
    test_start_t = min(r["t"] for r in results["naive"]["records"])
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 5))
    ax.plot(df["date"], df["revenue"], color="lightgray",
            label="actual (full history)")
    ax.plot(df["date"].iloc[test_start_t:], results["naive"]["actuals"],
            color="black", lw=2, label="actual (test window)")
    colors = {"naive": "tab:orange", "seasonal-naive": "tab:green",
              "ewma-0.3": "tab:red"}
    for name in FORECASTERS:
        dates = [r["date"] for r in results[name]["records"]]
        ax.plot(dates, results[name]["predictions"], linestyle="--",
                color=colors[name], alpha=0.9, label=f"predicted ({name})")
    ax.axvline(df["date"].iloc[test_start_t], color="gray", ls=":", lw=1)
    ax.set_title("Walk-forward one-step-ahead forecasts vs actuals (test window)")
    ax.set_xlabel("date")
    ax.set_ylabel("weekly revenue")
    ax.legend()
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(path, dpi=120)
    plt.close(fig)
    return path


def write_report(results: dict, md_path: str = MD_PATH) -> None:
    lines = [
        "# Backtest Report — Walk-Forward One-Step-Ahead Forecasts",
        "",
        "Data: 2 years of weekly revenue (seed 5), multiplicative seasonality.",
        f"Test window: last {len(results['naive']['records'])} weeks, expanding-window training.",
        "",
        "| model | MAE | RMSE | sMAPE (%) |",
        "|---|---|---|---|",
    ]
    for name in FORECASTERS:
        m = results[name]["metrics"]
        lines.append(
            f"| {name} | {m['MAE']:.2f} | {m['RMSE']:.2f} | {m['sMAPE (%)']:.4f} |"
        )
    lines += ["", f"![actual vs predicted]({PNG_PATH})", ""]
    with open(md_path, "w") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(lines))


def main() -> None:
    df = generate()
    results = run_backtest(df)
    png = make_chart(df, results)
    write_report(results)
    print(f"wrote {png} and {MD_PATH}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
